name: Chimps Horror
summary:
Run. Climb. Scream.
Chimps Horror is a VR horror game where you're a chimp trying to survive in creepy, dark environments — and you're not alone.

Using physics-based movement inspired by games like Gorilla Tag, you’ll swing, leap, and scramble your way through terrifying maps full of jumpscares, spooky vibes, and lurking monsters. Whether you're messing around with friends or playing solo, every corner hides a surprise.

This is a fan-made game built for fun and fear. Expect chaos, bugs, laughs, and scares
